title: H-Instanton Bundles on Three-Dimensional Smooth Toric Varieties with Picard Number Two
summary: We study $H$-instanton bundles on the infinite family of smooth three-dimensional varieties $X_e=\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2} \oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(e))$, for $e \geq 0$. We provide two distinct monadic descriptions of $H$-instanton bundles on $X_e$, generalizing the classical monads on $\mathbb P^3$. We then characterize $H$-instanton bundles with second Chern class supported in a single degree, and investigate their existence and moduli spaces. Finally, for $e\leq 3$, we prove the existence of $H$-instanton bundles for all admissible second Chern classes. These results…
